# Token scope is the expedition settler or new-holding province. Source packets live on exact provinces.

aawc_stage4_expedition_clear_terminal_receipt_effect = {
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_requested
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_reserved
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_remaining
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_source_count
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_validated_count
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_validated_total

	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_destination
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_receipt_credited
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_receipt_delta
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_receipt_released
	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_result
	clear_variable_list = aawc_stage4_tx_sources

	remove_variable = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_60_plus

# Planning metadata is deliberately non-demographic.
aawc_stage4_expedition_plan_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_state } NOT = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_state = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_planned_cost value = { value = $AMOUNT$ min = 0 floor = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_planned_destination value = $DESTINATION$ }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_state value = 0 }
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_band_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining > 0 var:$BAND$ > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available value = var:$BAND$ }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $RESERVED$ } add = var:$RESERVED$ } } multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_available < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_take value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_available }
		if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_take > scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_take value = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining } }
		change_variable = { name = $RESERVED$ add = var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_take }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_remaining add = { value = prev.var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_take multiply = -1 } } }
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_band_take
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_adult_band_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining > 0 var:$BAND$ > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available value = var:$BAND$ }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $RESERVED$ } add = var:$RESERVED$ } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = $MILITARY$ } add = var:$MILITARY$ } } multiply = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_available < 0 } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_take value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_available }
		if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_take > scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_band_take value = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining } }
		change_variable = { name = $RESERVED$ add = var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_take }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_remaining add = { value = prev.var:aawc_stage4_tx_band_take multiply = -1 } } }
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_band_available
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_band_take
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_source_effect = {
	aawc_reforging_cohort_ensure_production_ledger_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { aawc_stage4_unreserved_civilian_total > 0 NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_token } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_reservation_token value = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_sources target = prev }
			change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_source_count add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 value = 0 }

		aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_adult_band_effect = { BAND = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_25_29 RESERVED = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 MILITARY = aawc_reforging_military_age_25_29 }

		aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_adult_band_effect = { BAND = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_35_39 RESERVED = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 MILITARY = aawc_reforging_military_age_35_39 }

aawc_stage4_expedition_clear_source_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reservation_token ?= scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token }
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_token
	}
}

# Reserved travelers remain counted at rest but are detached during the
# synchronous monthly demographic tick. This freezes their exact bands
# so elapsed travel time cannot silently age or kill the packet; route
# loss is represented only by the explicit commit attrition receipt.
aawc_stage4_expedition_detach_reserved_packet_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_token
			NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_detached }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_00_04 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_05_09 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_10_14 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_15_19 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_20_24 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_25_29 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_30_34 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_35_39 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_40_44 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_45_49 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_50_54 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_55_59 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_60_plus >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } }
		}
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_00_04 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_05_09 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_10_14 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_15_19 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_20_24 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_25_29 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_30_34 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_35_39 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_40_44 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_45_49 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_50_54 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_55_59 add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } } multiply = -1 } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_60_plus add = { value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } } multiply = -1 } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_reservation_detached value = 1 }
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_reattach_reserved_packet_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_detached }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_00_04 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_05_09 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_10_14 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_15_19 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_20_24 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_25_29 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_30_34 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_35_39 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_40_44 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_45_49 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_50_54 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_55_59 add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } } }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_60_plus add = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } } }
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_detached
		aawc_reforging_cohort_reconcile_effect = yes
		aawc_reforging_cohort_refresh_mirrors_effect = yes
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_release_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_state = 1 var:aawc_stage4_tx_state = 4 } }
		save_scope_as = aawc_stage4_tx_token
		every_in_list = { variable = aawc_stage4_tx_sources aawc_stage4_expedition_clear_source_effect = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_state = 1 exists = var:aawc_stage4_tx_owner var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved > 0 }
			var:aawc_stage4_tx_owner = { aawc_population_release_reserved_amount_effect = { COST = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_released value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } add = var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_result value = 3 }
		clear_variable_list = aawc_stage4_tx_sources
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_state } NOT = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_state = 1 } } }
		aawc_stage4_expedition_clear_terminal_receipt_effect = yes
		aawc_stage4_expedition_plan_effect = { AMOUNT = $AMOUNT$ DESTINATION = $DESTINATION$ }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_requested value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_planned_cost }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_remaining value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_requested }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_source_count value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_owner value = $OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_destination value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_planned_destination }
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_planned_cost
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_planned_destination
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_state value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_result value = 1 }
		save_scope_as = aawc_stage4_tx_token
		$OWNER$ = {
			save_scope_as = aawc_stage4_tx_owner
			every_realm_province = {
				limit = {
					scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining > 0
					has_holding = yes
					county = { holder = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_owner }
					aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reservation_token }
				}
				aawc_stage4_expedition_reserve_source_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_requested > 0 var:aawc_stage4_tx_remaining = 0 var:aawc_stage4_tx_source_count > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_reserved value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_requested }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_state value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_result value = 2 }
			$OWNER$ = { aawc_population_add_reserved_amount_effect = { COST = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } }
		}
		else = {
			aawc_stage4_expedition_release_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_result value = 4 }
		}
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_validate_source_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:aawc_stage4_reservation_token ?= scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token
			has_holding = yes
			county = { holder = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_owner }
			aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_lock }
			aawc_stage4_reserved_packet_total > 0
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_00_04 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_05_09 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_10_14 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_15_19 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_20_24 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_25_29 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_30_34 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_35_39 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_40_44 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_45_49 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_50_54 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_55_59 >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } }
			var:aawc_reforging_cohort_age_60_plus >= { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } add = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } }
		}
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = {
			change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_validated_count add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_validated_total add = prev.aawc_stage4_reserved_packet_total }
		}
	}
	else = { scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_valid value = 0 } } }
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_commit_source_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_00_04 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_00_04 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_00_04 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_05_09 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_05_09 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_05_09 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_10_14 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_10_14 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_10_14 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_15_19 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_15_19 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_15_19 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_20_24 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_20_24 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_20_24 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_25_29 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_25_29 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_25_29 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_30_34 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_30_34 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_30_34 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_35_39 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_35_39 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_35_39 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_40_44 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_40_44 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_40_44 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_45_49 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_45_49 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_45_49 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_50_54 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_50_54 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_50_54 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_55_59 add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_55_59 add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_55_59 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_cohort_age_60_plus add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus multiply = -1 } }
		scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { change_variable = { name = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_60_plus add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited add = prev.var:aawc_stage4_reserved_age_60_plus } }
	}
	aawc_stage4_expedition_clear_source_effect = yes
	aawc_reforging_cohort_reconcile_effect = yes
	aawc_reforging_cohort_refresh_mirrors_effect = yes
	aawc_reforging_cohort_sync_legacy_population_effect = yes
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_record_attrition_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_00_04 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_00_04 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_00_04 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_05_09 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_05_09 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_05_09 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_10_14 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_10_14 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_10_14 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_15_19 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_15_19 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_15_19 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_20_24 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_20_24 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_20_24 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_25_29 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_25_29 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_25_29 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_30_34 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_30_34 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_30_34 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_35_39 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_35_39 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_35_39 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_40_44 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_40_44 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_40_44 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_45_49 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_45_49 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_45_49 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_50_54 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_50_54 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_50_54 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_55_59 value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_55_59 } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_55_59 } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition_age_60_plus value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = aawc_reforging_transfer_age_60_plus } add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_60_plus } } }
	set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_attrition value = aawc_stage4_transfer_pool_total }
}

# Call only after the native title/holder handoff. Invalid destinations release.
aawc_stage4_expedition_commit_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_state = 1 }
		save_scope_as = aawc_stage4_tx_token
		var:aawc_stage4_tx_owner = { save_scope_as = aawc_stage4_tx_owner }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_valid value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_validated_count value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_validated_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_commit_attrition value = { value = $ATTRITION$ min = 0 floor = yes } }
		if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_commit_attrition > var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_valid value = 0 } }
		every_in_list = { variable = aawc_stage4_tx_sources aawc_stage4_expedition_validate_source_effect = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_validated_count = var:aawc_stage4_tx_source_count } } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_valid value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_validated_total = var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } } set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_valid value = 0 } }
		$DESTINATION$ = {
			if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_holding = yes } has_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_lock has_holding_type = ruin_holding has_holding_type = wilderness_holding has_holding_type = unknown_holding county = { holder = { agot_is_dummy_character = yes } } } } scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token = { set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_valid value = 0 } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:aawc_stage4_tx_valid = 1 }
			aawc_reforging_cohort_reset_transfer_pool_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_debited value = 0 }
			every_in_list = { variable = aawc_stage4_tx_sources aawc_stage4_expedition_commit_source_effect = yes }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_credit_amount value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved }
			change_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_credit_amount add = { value = var:aawc_stage4_tx_commit_attrition multiply = -1 } }
			save_scope_as = aawc_reforging_transfer_pool_owner
			$DESTINATION$ = {
				# A funded pending holding becomes eligible only after every source
				# packet has validated and been debited. The destination ledger is
				# then rebuilt from zero before the exact packet is credited.
				remove_variable = aawc_stage4_pending_settlement
				aawc_reforging_cohort_ensure_production_ledger_effect = yes
				aawc_reforging_cohort_apply_transfer_packet_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_credit_amount }
				aawc_stage4_enter_colony_mode_effect = yes
				county = { aawc_population_recalculate_county_effect = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_credited value = $DESTINATION$.var:aawc_reforging_cohort_last_transfer_credit }
			aawc_stage4_expedition_record_attrition_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_receipt_delta value = aawc_stage4_receipt_reconciliation_delta }
			var:aawc_stage4_tx_owner = { aawc_population_release_reserved_amount_effect = { COST = scope:aawc_stage4_tx_token.var:aawc_stage4_tx_reserved } }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_state value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_result value = 5 }
			clear_variable_list = aawc_stage4_tx_sources
			aawc_reforging_cohort_cleanup_transfer_pool_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			aawc_stage4_expedition_release_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = aawc_stage4_tx_result value = 6 }
		}
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_valid
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_commit_attrition
		remove_variable = aawc_stage4_tx_credit_amount
	}
}

aawc_stage4_expedition_fail_effect = { aawc_stage4_expedition_release_effect = yes }
